_doc: Hosts that do NOT yet serve /version.json (the nav-core versionJsonPlugin output). Written by scripts/check-version-json-served.mjs --update-baseline; the list only shrinks: a host that starts serving is removed in the PR whose gitlink carries the adopting app, and a host reappearing here fails the gate. As of 2026-09-03 18:03 AWST ideas.crm7.app and d.ideas.crm7.app serve it (throughput, D-160 first adopter); the hosts listed here are the remaining non-serving ones until their apps adopt per R10.
